articles.title: LG TV shown scanning LAN for third-party phones and other devices
articles.summary: LG TVs are facing scrutiny due to a video seemingly showing the devices’ capability to track users when the TVs are off. YouTube channel Gamers Nexus worked with Level1Techs, a technology-focused YouTube channel, and security researchers to analyze LG TVs’ tracking capabilities. They shared packet captures that pointed to the TVs, including LG’s pricey G5 OLED TV, scanning the LAN for other devices. “The [G5] crawled our entire network and found dozens of unrelated devices, including smartwatches and phones of our staff who didn't even know we were working on this,” Steve Burke, Gamers Nexus' editor-in-chief, said. articles.title: Why this month's Microsoft patch release is a doozy
articles.summary: Microsoft’s patch for September is a doozy, with a record number of roughly 972 vulnerabilities fixed and 112 of them meeting the high critical-severity threshold. It was only two months ago that Microsoft patched a then-record 570 vulnerabilities. Then, last month, Microsoft patched some 620 of them. Google and other companies have also published record numbers of vulnerabilities in recent months. Two weeks ago, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Web Services, Google, Microsoft, and 100 companies and organizations published an open letter warning of a narrowing window for patching vulnerabilities ahead of an expected tsunami of AI-enabled attacks that actively exploit them first. The industry is taking the threat seriously by pumping out unprecedented numbers of patches in their software. Welcome

articles.title: SAP發布9月例行更新，修補4個重大漏洞
articles.summary: 9月8日SAP發布本月例行更新（Security Patch Day），修補19個資安弱點，並更新一則資安公告的內容。從危險程度來看，重大等級與高風險各有4個，中度風險有10個，低風險漏洞1個。根據CVSS嚴重程度評分，最危險的是記憶體中斷漏洞CVE-2026-44756，CVSS評分達到滿分10分，影響Extended Passport（EPP），未通過身分驗證的攻擊者可在特定情境下，利用含有惡意EPP標頭的特製請求觸發漏洞，有可能引起未定義的行為，或是造成程式異常終止。

articles.title: The Intersection Of AI And Voice At The Edge
articles.summary: Increasingly capable natural language processing is changing how audio systems are designed, integrated, and perceived. Voice has been used to navigate through menus for the better part of two decades, but the addition of AI has transformed it from often annoying and highly limited responses to numbers to a much more interactive human-machine interface. Amol Borkar, group director of product management and marketing for Tensilica DSPs at Cadence, examines how this technology will improve even further in the future, why the focus isn’t just about faster processors, and why this is so important for edge systems. The post The Intersection Of AI And Voice At The Edge appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering .

articles.title: An unofficial GTA 5 Android port might be coming soon, but not for your new Pixel phone
articles.summary: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR The developer behind an unofficial GTA 5 port for Nintendo Switch is apparently working on an Android port. This unofficial GTA 5 Android port will apparently require a Snapdragon 865 chipset or newer, along with 8GB of RAM, and 65GB of storage. There’s no word on a release date, but there are a couple of reasons Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to launch next month, but a developer has already unofficially ported Grand Theft Auto 5 to Nintendo Switch . Now, it looks like this same developer is working on porting GTA 5 to Android. A developer named mojso has confirmed on Discord that they’re working on an unofficial Android port of Grand Theft Auto 5. They previously ported the game to Nintendo Switch last month.

articles.title: My car is too old for Android Auto. Here’s how I used a spare phone to add it anyway
articles.summary: Working from home has its perks, the biggest being avoiding a hectic morning commute. That means that my car spends most of the week sitting in the driveway. I mostly just use it for the occasional weekend road trip, so I’ve never been able to justify upgrading my vehicle to a newer model with Android Auto support. Ironically, those road trips are where I miss having Android Auto support the most. For years, I’ve gotten around that limitation by mounting my phone on the dashboard and keeping Google Maps open. This solution obviously works, but it’s far from ideal. Buttons are small, switching between apps is awkward, and, for the most part, it’s flat-out dangerous when driving at expressway speeds.

articles.title: The Google Pixel 11 has an identity problem (and that’s okay)
articles.summary: Weeks after the Google Pixel 11 launch , it’s clear the most egregious change wasn’t the price hike. The Pixel 11 Pro XL costs the same as Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra, but Google could’ve justified the new price by boosting Tensor performance, doubling down on local AI features, or meaningfully changing the design. It didn’t do any of that. Google’s Tensor G6 chip is an iterative upgrade at best , my favorite Pixel exclusive uses cloud processing (Magic Capture), and the Pixel 11 Pro XL is still thicker and heavier than I’d like. To make matters worse, Google actually cut the amount of RAM on the Pro models from 16GB to 12GB.

articles.title: 數發部與八大部會啟動AI風險盤點，2027年前完成首輪法規調適
articles.summary:
「人工智慧基本法」在今年1月公布施行後，數發部7月已公布AI風險分類框架，並建置AI風險管理措施檢核系統，提供各部會推動AI治理的重要工具。數發部次長侯宜秀今天(9/9)表示，風險分類框架的定位並非直接管理AI技術，而是協助各主管機關盤點AI應用、辨識風險，並作為法規調適的基礎，讓不同部會能在一致的治理架構下推動AI應用。
她指出，AI基本法以上位的七大原則作為治理基礎，包括永續發展、人權保障、資料治理、隱私與安全、透明可解釋、公平不歧視及問責等原則，各部會未來在制定AI相關政策、行政措施及法規時，必須遵循這些原則。

Muse奠基在Muse Spark模型上。每位使用者在雲端擁有專屬的Muse Secure VM，裡面存放代理程式、個人資料與連接憑證；同時存在一個獨立的Sentinel代理於系統層面監督Muse對外執行的動作，只有在取得用戶同意或授權後才會執行。
